title: 进程与线程
text: 进程是资源分配的基本单位，线程是 CPU 调度的基本单位。同一进程的线程共享地址空间，切换开销小于进程切换。

title: 虚拟内存
text: 虚拟内存让程序看到连续的地址空间。页表记录虚拟页与物理页的映射，缺页时触发换入换出。

title: 死锁条件
text: 死锁产生的四个必要条件是互斥、占有等待、不可剥夺和循环等待，缺一不可。银行家算法用于死锁避免。

title: 进程调度
text: 时间片轮转给每个就绪进程分配固定时长，多级反馈队列兼顾交互与批处理作业。

title: 系统调用
text: 系统调用是用户态进入内核态的唯一受控入口，read 与 write 是最常用的文件类调用。

title: TCP 连接
text: TCP 通过三次握手建立连接，用序号与确认号保证可靠有序交付。

title: IP 地址
text: IPv4 地址为 32 位，点分十进制表示；IPv6 地址为 128 位，冒号十六进制表示。

title: 拥塞控制
text: 发送方维护拥塞窗口，丢包时减半窗口并进入慢启动，是互联网稳定的关键机制。

title: DNS 解析
text: DNS 把域名逐级解析为 IP 地址，递归查询与迭代查询分工不同。

title: HTTP 版本
text: HTTP/1.1 使用文本协议与短连接，HTTP/2 引入多路复用，HTTP/3 基于 QUIC。

title: 二分查找
text: 二分查找要求搜索空间有序，每次比较后排除一半区间，时间复杂度为对数级别。

title: 快速排序
text: 快速排序选取基准把数组分成两部分递归处理，平均时间复杂度为 n log n，最坏为平方级别。

title: 哈希表
text: 哈希表用哈希函数把键映射到槽位，冲突时链地址法把元素挂到同一槽位链表。

title: 动态规划
text: 动态规划把原问题分解为重叠子问题，备忘录避免重复计算，适用于最优子结构问题。

title: 近似算法
text: 对 NP 难问题可用近似算法在多项式时间内给出有保证界的解，贪心是常用策略。

title: 事务 ACID
text: 事务满足原子性、一致性、隔离性与持久性，数据库据此保证强一致性。

title: B+ 树索引
text: B+ 树索引把数据存于叶子并链表相连，范围查询只需顺序遍历叶子层。

title: 范式
text: 第三范式要求消除非主属性对候选键的传递依赖，是常用的关系模式设计目标。

title: 预写日志
text: 数据库先写预写日志再改数据页，崩溃后按日志重做与回滚，保证持久性。

title: 并发控制
text: 两阶段锁协议保证可串行化，死锁检测通过等待图发现循环并回滚牺牲者。

title: Paging
text: Paging divides memory into fixed-size frames. A page table maps each virtual page to a physical frame.

title: TCP handshake
text: TCP establishes a connection with a three-way handshake using sequence and acknowledgment numbers.

title: Binary search
text: Binary search needs a sorted array and halves the search interval on each comparison.

title: Hash table
text: A hash table maps keys to slots with a hash function and chains colliding entries in linked lists.

title: Quick sort
text: Quick sort partitions around a pivot and recurses. Average time is n log n and worst case is quadratic.

title: Congestion window
text: The sender keeps a congestion window, halving it on loss and growing it in slow start.

title: IPv6
text: IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long and written in colon hexadecimal notation.

title: WAL
text: Write-ahead logging records changes before data pages, so crash recovery can redo and undo safely.

title: B+ tree
text: B+ tree indexes keep data in linked leaves, so range scans walk the leaf level in order.

title: Deadlock
text: Deadlock needs mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, and circular wait together.

title: Threads
text: Threads of one process share the address space, so context switches cost less than process switches.

title: DNS
text: DNS resolves domain names level by level into IP addresses with recursive and iterative queries.

title: Dynamic programming
text: Dynamic programming memoizes overlapping subproblems and fits problems with optimal substructure.

title: ACID
text: Atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability together give transactions strong guarantees.

title: HTTP/2
text: HTTP/2 multiplexes many streams over one connection instead of plain-text sequential requests.

title: Approximation
text: Approximation algorithms trade optimality for polynomial time with provable bounds on hard problems.

title: Scheduling
text: Round robin gives each ready process a fixed quantum, while feedback queues favor interactive jobs.

title: Normal forms
text: Third normal form removes transitive dependencies of non-key attributes on candidate keys.

title: System calls
text: System calls are the controlled gate from user mode to kernel mode for privileged operations.

title: Two-phase locking
text: Two-phase locking guarantees serializability, and wait-for graphs detect deadlocks for rollback.
